proofCallbackArrival: אחזור אליך תוך {time} ואתאם איתך מועד הגעה.
proofCallbackArrivalSameDay: אחזור אליך עוד באותו יום ואתאם איתך מועד הגעה.

_rules._matching: All qa*Tokens lists use the existing hasTopicToken semantics (whole word or phrase, at most one attached prefix letter from PREFIX_LETTERS; a token with no letter, e.g. 24/7, matches as a substring). Order per pool question: (1) qaAvailabilityQuestionTokens -> drop; (2) questionTopic() as today; (3) if the detected topic has an exclude list and any entry matches -> drop (never to the model); (4) topic-specific shape rules below; (5) build the item. An exclude list is consulted ONLY for the topic that was detected; it never creates a topic. Dropped = the question is removed from the pool entirely (not answered by code, not sent to the model).
_rules.qaResponseQuestionTokens: BLOCKING list. Marks a question about how fast the business answers or comes: callback-phrased and arrival-phrased both. Deliberately NOT listed: bare 'כמה זמן' (catches job duration and 'how long in the trade'), bare 'מהר' (catches 'why does the clog come back so fast'), bare 'מיידי' (catches 'is there an instant fix'), bare 'היום'. 'דחוף' family is in: an urgent-call question is answered honestly by the callback proof; advice-shaped urgent questions are removed by the exclude list ('מה עושים', 'זה דחוף', 'נחשב').
_rules.qaResponseQuestionExcludeTokens: Response-topic questions the callback proof does not answer: job duration / completion ('תוך כמה זמן מסיימים'), drying, results (pest control), re-entry / use after the job ('באותו יום אפשר לגור'), part supply, what-to-do-meanwhile advice, 'is X urgent' classification, and emergency-service existence ('חירום': 'I will call back in 20 minutes' does not say whether there is an emergency service). Matched -> drop.
_rules.qaResponseCallbackShapeTokens: Item 3, my call: arrival questions are ANSWERED, honestly, not excluded. Shape rule: use proofCallback / proofCallbackSameDay ONLY when the question matches this list AND does not match qaResponseArrivalShapeTokens. Every other response-topic question (arrival-phrased, or neutral such as 'כמה מהר אפשר לקבל שירות') gets proofCallbackArrival / proofCallbackArrivalSameDay. Default to the arrival variant because it is the one that never lets the reader read a callback time as an arrival time.
_rules.qaResponseArrivalShapeTokens: Arrival markers; any match forces the arrival variant even when a callback token is also present ('תוך כמה זמן מגיעים מרגע הפנייה').
_rules.proofCallbackArrival: NEW. The honest answer to an arrival question when the owner fact is a CALLBACK time: it states only what the owner gave (the callback) and then the true next step (scheduling). It never states an arrival time. 'אתאם' is first person future, gender-neutral for the owner; 'מועד הגעה' is also neutral about who arrives, so it is true for trades where the customer comes in. Same {time} values as proofCallback (response*). Same gating as proofCallback: no fact with a place tail (Adam's decision stands), none on install pages (planQa already returns null there). 40-47 code points with the longest {time}; fits the Q&A limits.
_rules.proofCallbackArrivalSameDay: NEW. Same-day form of proofCallbackArrival. Reads as: I'll get back to you the same day and set an arrival time with you. It does NOT claim same-day arrival.
_rules.qaAvailabilityQuestionTokens: NEW, always drop, before topic detection. Shabbat / night / holiday / weekend / 24-7 / emergency-service questions. There is no owner field for availability, so code cannot answer them, and the model must not (it would invent 'we work on Shabbat'). Phrases are verb-bound ('עובדים בשבת', not bare 'בשבת') so 'can I sleep at home tonight after spraying' is not caught. Overlap with the price topic: 'יש תוספת בשבת?' contains no listed phrase and stays a price question (see qaPriceSurchargeQuestionTokens).
_rules.qaPriceQuestionExcludeTokens: Item 3, price. The cost-FAQ answer ('המחיר ל{service} ב{city} מתחיל מ־{amount}.' + optional callout + optional night/Shabbat surcharge) truly answers ONLY: how much does it cost / what is the price / price range / is it expensive. It does NOT answer: will the price change mid-job, extra or hidden charges, fixed / final / guaranteed price, what is included (parts, materials, VAT, warranty in the price), payment methods and instalments, free quote / how to get a quote / quote by phone, price of parts or of buying a device, comparisons ('why more expensive', 'cheapest'), what drives the price, and is-it-worth-it questions. Matched -> drop. Known recall cost: 'מה משפיע על המחיר' is a good question and is dropped; that is the safe trade (no guessed price).
_rules.qaPriceCalloutQuestionTokens: NEW, conditional. A price question that matches this list asks about the visit / diagnosis fee: answer with the cost FAQ ONLY when pricing.calloutFee is not null (so costFaqAnswerCallout is in the answer); otherwise drop.
_rules.qaPriceSurchargeQuestionTokens: NEW, conditional. A price question that matches this list asks about a night / Shabbat / holiday surcharge: answer ONLY when pricing.surchargePolicy is set (costFaqAnswerSurcharge is in the answer); otherwise drop. Note: price detection still uses costQuestionTokens, so 'יש תוספת בלילה?' with no cost token is not a price question; it falls through to the other topics and then the model. Engineer: if that matters, add this list to price detection; I have not changed costQuestionTokens.
_rules.qaLicenseQuestionTokens: Replaces the fallback (license_grade tokens + the licence noun family). Adds the certified and registered-contractor forms. Deliberately NOT listed: 'מורשה' (in Israeli trade questions it means brand-authorised service, e.g. 'טכנאי מורשה של אלקטרה', not a licence), and 'תעודה' / 'תעודת' (licence is first in priority, so 'תעודת אחריות' would land in licence). 'מאסטר' is not an Israeli grade and is not listed.
_rules.qaLicenseQuestionExcludeTokens: The licence proof ('יש לי {license}.') answers 'are you licensed / certified / registered' about THE OWNER. It does not answer: does the CUSTOMER need a permit or licence ('צריך היתר', 'חובה', 'נדרש', 'מותר'), business / driving / vehicle licences, brand authorisation ('יצרן'), insurance (an answer that skips it implies nothing either way, so drop), and questions about staff ('האם כל הטכנאים מוסמכים': the owner's licence says nothing about employees). Matched -> drop.
_rules.qaYearsQuestionTokens: Raises recall over the template phrases. Bare 'ניסיון' is listed on purpose; its advice-shaped uses ('לפי הניסיון שלך, כל כמה זמן...') are removed by the exclude list. Not listed: business-age questions ('כמה זמן העסק קיים'): years in the trade is not the age of the business.
_rules.qaYearsQuestionExcludeTokens: The years proof ('אני במקצוע כבר {n} שנים.') answers only the owner's time in the trade. Drop: advice framed as experience, experience with a specific model or job ('ניסיון עם'), whether you NEED an experienced pro, staff experience, and business-age questions.
_rules.qaWarrantyQuestionTokens: Replaces the warranty claim token ('אחריות') and adds repeat-fault phrasings ('מה קורה אם התקלה חוזרת?'), which the warranty proof answers. 'מתחייב' is NOT listed: 'מתחייבים למחיר / לזמן' belongs to price / response.
_rules.qaWarrantyQuestionExcludeTokens: The warranty proof answers: is there a warranty, for how long, and (scoped or verbatim proof only) on what. It does NOT answer: manufacturer / device warranty, parts, written certificate ('בכתב', 'תעודת אחריות': the proof does not say written; also the written_guarantee claim), how to claim, extended warranty, out-of-warranty or expired, whether a repair voids a warranty, and 'whose responsibility' questions (the same noun means 'responsibility': 'באחריות מי לתקן את הצנרת המשותפת'). Note 'האם העבודה באחריות?' is a real warranty question, so bare 'באחריות' is NOT excluded.
_rules.qaWarrantyScopeQuestionTokens: NEW, conditional. A warranty question that asks what the warranty covers: answer ONLY with proofWarrantyScoped or proofWarrantyVerbatim (the owner said what it covers). With the unscoped proofWarranty ('על העבודה שלי', picker answer, no scope given) -> drop; the owner never told us what is covered.
_rules.contractorLicenseQuestion: Item 4. Replaces licenseQuestion for the contractor tier (credentialTier 'contractor'). Same voice as the credentials-step file: short, male singular, 'אתה'. 'קבלן רשום' is the term owners themselves use; the registry is not named in the question, to keep it one line.
_rules.contractorLicenseYes: Replaces licenseYes for contractors ('כן, יש לי' does not answer 'are you registered?').
_rules.contractorLicenseNo: Replaces licenseNo for contractors ('אין לי' does not answer 'are you registered?'). 'לא' is in parseNegationWords, so it is also safe if it ever reaches the field (it should map to 'no' in code and never be stored).
_rules.contractorLicenseTypePrompt: Replaces licenseTypePrompt for contractors. Optional detail: branch and classification (ענף / סיווג), the way the registry lists them.
_rules.contractorLicenseTypePlaceholder: Replaces licenseTypePlaceholder for contractors. 'ענף 100' = general building, 'ג1' = a real classification; the example is a format, not a claim about the owner.
_rules.trustContractorRegistered: NEW. Trust chip when the contractor answered yes. The detail is NOT in the chip (keeps the chip short; the detail goes in the proof). Engineer: contractor answers must NOT go through trustLicense / proofLicense, because the yes answer alone has no licence text and a typed detail ('ענף 100, סיווג ג1') would render as a meaningless chip and the bare proof 'ענף 100, סיווג ג1.'.
_rules.proofContractorRegistered: NEW. Proof sentence for a yes with no usable detail. Gender-neutral for the owner (no 'אני קבלן'). 'פנקס הקבלנים' is the statutory register; being a registered contractor means being listed there, so it adds no claim beyond the yes.
_rules.proofContractorRegisteredDetail: NEW. Yes plus a typed detail. {detail} = the owner's text verbatim, trailing punctuation stripped, when: mostly Hebrew (isMostlyHebrew), at most 30 code points, digits allowed, it does not start with a parseNegationWords entry, and it does not start with 'קבלן' or 'רישום' (it would repeat the sentence). A detail that fails -> proofContractorRegistered (the yes still holds; the detail is dropped, never paraphrased). Example: 'ענף 100, סיווג ג1' -> 'יש לי רישום בפנקס הקבלנים, ענף 100, סיווג ג1.'
